name: compress.gzip
doc:
gzip files (RFC 1952): members of header + raw DEFLATE + CRC-32 and
size. Decompress and Reader read concatenated members as one stream,
like gzip -d.

items.name: Compress
items.doc: Compresses data into one member with an empty header.
items.summary: Compresses data into one member with an empty header.

items.name: CompressHeader
items.signature: func CompressHeader(data []byte, level int, h Header) []byte
items.doc: Compresses data into one member with header fields h.
items.summary: Compresses data into one member with header fields h.

items.name: Decompress
items.doc: Decompresses all members of a gzip file.
items.summary: Decompresses all members of a gzip file.

items.name: NewStreamReader
items.doc: NewStreamReader returns a reader of the decompressed data of src.
items.summary: NewStreamReader returns a reader of the decompressed data of src.

items.name: NewStreamWriter
items.doc: NewStreamWriter returns a writer that gzips everything written to it into dst.
items.summary: NewStreamWriter returns a writer that gzips everything written to it into dst.

items.name: NewWriter
items.doc: NewWriter returns a compressor with level (0-9, -1 for the default).
items.summary: NewWriter returns a compressor with level (0-9, -1 for the default).

items.name: ReadHeader
items.doc: The header of the first member.
items.summary: The header of the first member.

items.name: Header
items.doc:
The optional header fields of a member. ModTime is Unix seconds (0:
unset); OS is the RFC 1952 operating system byte (255: unknown).
items.summary: The optional header fields of a member.

items.name: Reader
items.doc:
A streaming gzip decompressor over concatenated members; checksums and
sizes are verified at the end of each member.
items.summary: A streaming gzip decompressor over concatenated members; checksums and sizes are verified at the end of each member.

members.name: Feed
members.doc: Feed decompresses the next chunk of input; read the output with Bytes.
members.summary: Feed decompresses the next chunk of input; read the output with Bytes.

members.name: Read
members.doc: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.

members.name: Header
members.doc: The header of the first member (nil before it was read).
members.summary: The header of the first member (nil before it was read).

members.name: Done
members.doc: True when at least one member ended and no other one is in progress.
members.summary: True when at least one member ended and no other one is in progress.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close fails if the input ended in the middle of a member.
members.summary: Close fails if the input ended in the middle of a member.

items.name: StreamReader
items.doc:
io adapters: gzip.NewStreamReader(src) is an io.Reader of the
decompressed data of src; gzip.NewStreamWriter(dst, level) is an
io.Writer that writes gzip data to dst (Close writes the trailer).
items.summary: io adapters: gzip.NewStreamReader(src) is an io.Reader of the decompressed data of src; gzip.NewStreamWriter(dst, level) is an io.Writer that writes gzip data to dst (Close writes the trailer).

members.name: Read
members.doc: Read returns up to len(buf) decompressed bytes; 0 at the end.
members.summary: Read returns up to len(buf) decompressed bytes; 0 at the end.

members.name: Header
members.doc: The header of the first member (nil before it was read).
members.summary: The header of the first member (nil before it was read).

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write compresses buf and writes the output produced so far to dst.
members.summary: Write compresses buf and writes the output produced so far to dst.

members.name: Flush
members.doc: Flush flushes the compressor and writes the output to dst.
members.summary: Flush flushes the compressor and writes the output to dst.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close finishes the stream and writes the rest (with the trailer) to dst.
members.summary: Close finishes the stream and writes the rest (with the trailer) to dst.

members.name: SetHeader
members.doc: SetHeader sets the gzip header (before the first Write).
members.summary: SetHeader sets the gzip header (before the first Write).

items.name: Writer
items.doc: A streaming gzip compressor: set Header before the first Write.
items.summary: A streaming gzip compressor: set Header before the first Write.

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write compresses p (writing the header first).
members.summary: Write compresses p (writing the header first).

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString compresses the bytes of s.
members.summary: WriteString compresses the bytes of s.

members.name: Flush
members.doc: Flush emits everything written so far (a deflate sync flush); read it with Bytes.
members.summary: Flush emits everything written so far (a deflate sync flush); read it with Bytes.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close finishes the stream and appends the trailer (CRC-32 and size).
members.summary: Close finishes the stream and appends the trailer (CRC-32 and size).

members.name: Bytes
members.doc: The compressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The compressed bytes produced since the last call.
